name: RIKA2MQTT
description: Rika2Mqtt is a free and opensource bridge enabling end-users to connect their RIKA firenet stove to an MQTT server. It goes both way so you can monitor and also take control of your stove directly via MQTT.

variables.name: MQTT server
variables.description: The host of your MQTT instance (ip of fqdn)

variables.name: MQTT username
variables.description: If your mqtt server allow anonymous access leave empty

variables.name: MQTT password
variables.description: If your mqtt server allow anonymous access leave empty

variables.name: MQTT telemetry topic name
variables.description: The topic used by RIKA2MQTT to publish RIKA status

variables.name: MQTT notification topic name
variables.description: The topic used by RIKA2MQTT to publish notifications (RIKA errors etc)

variables.name: MQTT command topic name
variables.description: The topic used to send command to RIKA2MQTT.

variables.name: MQTT URI Scheme
variables.description: The uri scheme to use to connect to MQTT
